import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        if (args.length > 0) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(args[0]));
        }

        solve(br, pw, false);
        pw.close();
    }

    public static void solve(BufferedReader br, PrintWriter pw, boolean multipleTestMode) throws IOException {
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long p = Long.parseLong(input[0]);
        long k = Long.parseLong(input[1]);

        if (multipleTestMode && br.ready() == false) {
            return;
        }

        pw.println("\nNext test: " + p + " " + k + "\n");

        if (k == 0) {
            long ans = powMod(p, p - 1, 1000000007);
            pw.println(ans);
            return;
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            long ans = powMod(p, p, 1000000007);
            pw.println(ans);
            return;
        }

        long groups = 0;
        boolean[] used = new boolean[(int) p + 1];
        long ans = 1;

        for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
            if (used[(int) x]) {
                continue;
            }

            groups += 1;
            ans = (ans * p) % 1000000007;

            used[(int) x] = true;

            long v = x;
            while (used[(int) (v * k % p)] == false) {
                used[(int) (v * k % p)] = true;
                v = (v * k) % p;
            }
        }

        pw.println(ans);
    }

    public static long powMod(long a, long b, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        long mask = 1;
        long powPart = a;

        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            if ((b & mask) != 0) {
                res = (res * powPart) % mod;
            }
            mask <<= 1;
            powPart = (powPart * powPart) % mod;
        }

        return res;
    }
}
